select id, conversation_type, conversation_id, sender_id, recipient_id, content, created_at from cf_chat_message where conversation_type = #{conversationType} and conversation_id = #{conversationId}
and ((sender_id = #{senderId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId}) or (sender_id = #{recipientId} and recipient_id = #{senderId}))
and (sender_id = #{recipientId} or recipient_id = #{recipientId})
order by id asc
